name: Futaba Natsuho
source: Natsuho is a popular schoolgirl who teaches the protagonist how to be more fashionable as a favor to her former senpai. Although she is a little self-centered, she is a good girl who cares about others while aiming to be a mature woman. An adult woman, in Natsuho's eyes, is one who initiates romantic interactions and is not shy about pursuing the attention of men. As such, she acts a bit mature compared to her age, but she can be devilish or shameless when she wants to!
